messages.subject: Database for R
parts:
I develop a statistical database in Public Health -
http://stat.sqlab.ru (for English version use Google
Translator). There is a lot of data about demografic, burth,
mortality, morbidity in Russia. The database is
constantly updated by new data and tools. It have export
in R. Further planing to get own server and install
Rapache.
That data is planing to use in research with scientists from
Central Michigan University. Welcome to collaborate for
provide researches using R, especially for creating neuronal
net and artifical intelligence.
